concept: A bright twin-wind observatory expressing curiosity, conversation, and mirrored motion.
floor: One continuous smooth pale sky-blue plaster floor across the full top face, with one broad cream tonal sweep and no divided halves, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: Two matching compact crescent observatory arches at the rear, mirrored left and right around a clear open center, using large cream and sky-blue masses.
rear_props: two oversized paired floating star-orbs on sturdy short stands
side_props: one chunky cream cloud-form bench on each upper side
one large pale-gold lantern on each upper side

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded powder-blue wall with alternating broad cream cap sections

lighting: soft clear morning light with two balanced warm lantern pools
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as one quiet open plaster floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, animal, twins, people, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
zodiac glyph, constellation, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, split floor, or indentation
bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, star specks, tiny props, cracks, or dense clutter
